asked.item: Starter posts published before upgrading: do they move to the Creator checkpoint schedule or keep the Starter schedule
Whether to republish a few posts based on this

verdict.reason: The sentences give each plan's checkpoint schedule (S5, S6, S9, S10) but never say which schedule applies to posts published before a plan change, and the republish decision is not covered beyond an empty-chart note (S108) that does not fit this case.
